cues: Brake at 8% into the lap, arriving ~32 mph.
Apex ~18 mph, drive out to 21 mph.
Apex speed swings ±4 mph lap-to-lap — aim to repeat 18.
braking_zones.label: B1

notes: All points DERIVED FROM THE DRIVEN GPS LINE (speed/curvature) of your best Sector-1 flying lap, in lap-fraction - NOT from satellite seed pins or absolute GPS metres (those disagree by several m). Out-lap excluded. Braking zones = where you actually decelerate.
